Done. Shelf keeps a map of counts; Remove returns ErrShort and changes nothing when the shelf holds fewer units than asked for, and a SKU that falls to 0 stays in the map. There are tests for adding, removing and totalling, and for a Remove that asks for too many. go test ./... passes.
Nice. I'm stopping here, tell me what we still owe the README.

Two methods of the README are left. ReorderBelow(limit) returns the SKUs whose count is below the limit, sorted, with SKUs at 0 included; that is why Remove keeps a SKU at 0 instead of deleting it. MergeShelf(other) adds every count of the other shelf and leaves the other shelf as it was. Neither exists yet, and nothing else in the README is missing.
